document.abstract: SMPTE is proud to present what has become an annual issue on the topic of artificial intelligence (AI) and machine learning (ML). In this issue, we bring together a group of professionals and students to explore AI, ML, and some new applications in our industry. Whether you are an AI expert or just beginning to explore this exciting field, we are sure that you will find valuable insights that will spark your imagination.

authors.bio: Steve Bilow has worked in software engineering, marketing, training, and project management with Tektronix, Grass Valley, Planar Systems, and Telestream for over 35 years. He has operated and implemented video and audio test equipment since the 1970s and was first published in the SMPTE journal in 2001. Bilow is a member of SMPTE’s Board of Editors and the Association for Computing Machinery (ACM), where he serves on several committees on artificial intelligence and data privacy. He is based in Portland, OR.
